execution: UNEXECUTED source/failure-injection cases; static inspection only

cases.expect: Restricted reader and private temporary stdin/file transport; initial registration belongs only to installer setup; no token in argv, logs, receipt, catalog or target controller.
Use the compiled public URL and never read PRESEED_CI_GITHUB_URL.

cases.given: Selected runner has no enrollment token
cases.expect: Install verified artifact, identity, isolated rootless store and configuration policy; retain installed-but-pending, no service link or online claim.
Separate UID/GID, subuid/subgid, home, credentials, build/cache directories, sockets and state; configure once per provider, no shared management socket.

cases.given: Public forks or untrusted projects requested for the dedicated private host
cases.expect: Refuse the unsupported trust contract; no privileged job, blanket sudo or host management-socket fallback.
Use the selected suite's pinned Debian slim image, if-not-present pull policy and explicit native version-matched Debian-derived Ubuntu helper; no host CI toolchain install.

cases.given: Job chooses multiple custom container images
cases.expect: No host image allowlist forces a single toolchain image; job owns its dependencies and remote-cache credentials.
Preserve native image-pull semantics; do not invent a GitLab-like GitHub pull-policy environment option.
Bazel, BuildBuddy configuration and Cargo/Go/Node/ccache/tmp state resolve into the selected provider's work/cache tree on /pool; neither provider sees the other store.

cases.given: Registration command times out or native credential verification fails after registration may have occurred
cases.expect: Retain enrollment-uncertain and native evidence; return outcome unknown without automatic retry, deletion or online status.

cases.given: Native .runner/.credentials or GitLab config exists without terminal receipt
cases.expect: Refuse adoption/re-registration and retain evidence for the operator.

cases.given: Enrollment input is a FIFO, symlink or changes identity during read
cases.expect: Reject using bounded nonblocking nofollow capture before native mutation.

cases.given: GITHUB_ENV is outside the native work/_temp/_runner_file_commands directory or is replaced with a link
cases.expect: Refuse cache environment publication; never write outside the provider-owned work tree.

cases.given: Native GitLab verify exits zero after a network failure
cases.expect: Require authenticated 200 JSON acknowledgement bound to the native manager system ID before activation; retain enrollment-uncertain on failure, no online claim.

cases.given: Provider redirects the private runner verification request
cases.expect: Do not follow; never send the private token to a new destination; retain uncertain evidence.

cases.given: Manager ID missing/replaced, response malformed/oversized, duplicate JSON fields or verification timeout
cases.expect: Reject with sanitized failure and bounded cleanup; no service activation or automatic native registration retry.

cases.given: Root-owned protected runner home with a private runner-owned config directory
cases.expect: Use FILE_SERVER_GITLAB_CONFIG for native config and adjacent manager identity/token rotation; keep root-owned receipts outside that writable directory.

cases.given: Frozen role reader fails with status 37 before server foundation/service iteration
cases.expect: Propagate status 37 before consuming any role output; do not treat empty here-document output as completed installation.
